raw_graphql_pull_request.body:
Temporary AI-assisted diagnostics for the TP=2 startup/forward timeout in [Intel CI build 15354](https://buildkite.com/vllm/intel-ci/builds/15354#01a17636-cc33-476f-895c-61788cf0d7fe), extending this existing debug PR rather than opening a competing fix. Adds XPU-only `torch.xpu.synchronize()` before/after worker and MRV1/MRV2 loading, profiling, input preparation, forward and sampling, plus Llama embedding/layer/attention/MLP boundaries and 30-second worker stack dumps. Logs include rank/PID/thread/device/stage and synchronization begin/end; exception unwinding never synchronizes, compiled model internals bypass diagnostics, and graph capture skips synchronization.

**DO NOT MERGE:** blocking synchronization intentionally changes timing and performance and may mask races; this is evidence gathering, not a confirmed fix. Retains the existing two-iteration shutdown loop and XCCL/signal diagnostics. Human review is required before any merge.

**Validation:** Intel Arc Pro B60, devices 6/7; pre-commit passed. Before adding model-level markers, shutdown selection: **10 passed, 4 skipped**; final model instrumentation: MRV2 **4 passed** (including TP=2 startup/runtime errors, successful generation/shutdown, and compiled in-process execution), MRV1 TP=2 **1 passed**. Both ranks emitted Llama projection/layer synchronization markers; fullgraph decorator/context tracing also passed. No local timeout reproduction; the existing injected startup test also emits a rank-1 argument `TypeError`, so its pass alone does not establish correct peer-forward behavior. Some runs report multiprocessing resource-tracker warnings on exit.

<details>
<summary>Final end-to-end test and lint commands</summary>

```bash
ZE_AFFINITY_MASK=6,7 VLLM_WORKER_MULTIPROC_METHOD=spawn timeout 720s .venv/bin/python -m pytest --timeout=120 -v -s \
  'tests/v1/shutdown/test_startup_error.py::test_async_llm_startup_error[forward-2-hmellor/tiny-random-LlamaForCausalLM]' \
  'tests/v1/shutdown/test_forward_error.py::test_async_llm_model_error[hmellor/tiny-random-LlamaForCausalLM-2]' \
  'tests/v1/shutdown/test_delete.py::test_async_llm_delete[True-2-hmellor/tiny-random-LlamaForCausalLM]' \
  'tests/v1/shutdown/test_delete.py::test_llm_delete_inprocess[True-hmellor/tiny-random-LlamaForCausalLM]'

ZE_AFFINITY_MASK=6,7 VLLM_USE_V2_MODEL_RUNNER=0 VLLM_WORKER_MULTIPROC_METHOD=spawn timeout 300s .venv/bin/python -m pytest --timeout=120 -v -s \
  tests/v1/shutdown/test_delete.py -k 'test_async_llm_delete and True and 2-hmellor'

.venv/bin/pre-commit run --files vllm/utils/torch_utils.py vllm/model_executor/models/llama.py vllm/v1/worker/gpu_worker.py vllm/v1/worker/gpu/model_runner.py vllm/v1/worker/gpu_model_runner.py vllm/v1/worker/xpu_worker.py
```

</details>

 logger = init_logger(__name__)
 
 
+@contextlib.contextmanager
+def xpu_forward_debug(stage: str) -> Iterator[None]:
+    """Temporary blocking diagnostics for the XPU shutdown debug PR."""
+    if torch.compiler.is_compiling():
+        yield
+        return
+
+    from vllm.platforms import current_platform
+
+    if not current_platform.is_xpu():
+        yield
+        return
+
+    start = time.monotonic()
+    rank = torch.distributed.get_rank() if torch.distributed.is_initialized() else -1
+    identity = (
+        f"stage={stage} rank={rank} pid={os.getpid()} "
+        f"thread={threading.get_ident()} device={torch.xpu.current_device()}"
+    )
+
+    def checkpoint(phase: str) -> None:
+        logger.warning(
+            "[xpu-forward-diag] %s phase=%s sync.begin elapsed=%.6fs",
+            identity,
+            phase,
+            time.monotonic() - start,
+        )
+        if torch.xpu.is_current_stream_capturing():
+            logger.warning(
+                "[xpu-forward-diag] %s phase=%s sync.skipped(capture)",
+                identity,
+                phase,
+            )
+        else:
+            torch.xpu.synchronize()
+            logger.warning(
+                "[xpu-forward-diag] %s phase=%s sync.end elapsed=%.6fs",
+                identity,
+                phase,
+                time.monotonic() - start,
+            )
+
+    try:
+        checkpoint("enter")
+        logger.warning("[xpu-forward-diag] %s body.begin", identity)
+        yield
+        logger.warning("[xpu-forward-diag] %s body.end", identity)
+        checkpoint("exit")
+    except Exception:
+        # Do not synchronize while unwinding: a peer may be waiting in a collective.
+        logger.exception("[xpu-forward-diag] %s exception (no cleanup sync)", identity)
+        raise
+
